title: Local supplied-tensorator shift gauge on flat telescope models
statement: Let f: Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with module-sheaf derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], F = derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback] supplied with a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put Q = Qh_Y and G = H followed by Qh_Z. Let ε: Q⋙F → G exhibit F as a left derived functor, and give F a coherent integer shift for which ε commutes with shifts. Put Ctel(X) = flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. There exist e: F(O_Y[1]) ≅ O_Z[1] and isomorphisms r_X: (Q⋙F)(X) ≅ (Q⋙F)(X) for X satisfying Ctel, such that (Q⋙F)(s);r_Xprime = r_X;(Q⋙F)(s) whenever s:X→Xprime is a stage-induced map [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] between such representatives. For every literal flat telescope P and X=q(P), r_(X[1]);commShift_(Q⋙F)(X) = F(commShift_Q(X));b(Q(X));r_X[1], where b(K) = F(c_Y(K) inverse);δ_F(O_Y[1],K);(e tensor id);c_Z(F(K)), and c is the canonical shifted-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. No natural transformation on all homotopy objects, or naturality for arbitrary morphisms between model representatives, is asserted.

proof.text: Compute the canonical shift comparison using bounded-above flat stages, their countable sum, and the cone of one minus transition. Use degree-zero and translated unit models.

Normalize the unit by the supplied monoidal unit map. Rewrite translation as tensor with the translated unit by the Koszul comparison and the translated left unitor. Apply the supplied inverse tensorator. Its two unit equations identify the unit normalizations, and its associativity equation identifies the tensor rewrites on the two summands of the transition cone. Take the ratio with the original representative comparison.

The ratios on the two cone summands commute with the transition and hence define invertible model components. Their equation is the asserted model gauge identity. The naturality of Koszul maps, unitors and the supplied tensorator makes the ratio commute with tower maps; sums and cones preserve the resulting commuting squares. Transport through the homotopy isomorphisms in a stage-map presentation. Common flat refinements compare presentations and identify the ratios after localization. This supplies only model components and stage-map naturality; descent to all objects is not asserted.

theorem exists_flat_telescope_model_shift_gauge
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
          schemeDerivedCategory Z))
    (hε : (derivedPullback f).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    [(derivedPullback f).CommShift ℤ] [NatTrans.CommShift ε ℤ] :
    ∃ e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ∃ a : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ≅
            (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X),
        (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X)
          (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X') (s : X ⟶ X'),
          flatTelescopeStageMap Y s →
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (a X' hX').hom =
            (a X hX).hom ≫ (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s) ∧
        ∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
          (htel : isFlatTelescope Y P),
        let X := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P
        (a (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ⟨P, htel, Or.inr rfl⟩).hom ≫
            ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X =
          (derivedPullback f).map ((DerivedCategory.Qh.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app X) ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso
                (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X)) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z
                ((derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj X))).hom ≫
            ((a X ⟨P, htel, Or.inl rfl⟩).hom)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
